name: 商品像素锁定_快餐盘示例
prompt: Keep the photograph exactly as it is. Add a soft natural contact shadow and a faint tabletop reflection directly under both plates, matching the warm daylight coming from the upper left. On the front plate, serve a low, naturally spread portion of steamed white rice with stir-fried pork strips and soft green pepper, lightly coated in a glossy brown sauce, with small shadows where the food touches the white surface. Leave a wide margin of clean white plate visible around the food.
